verdict.rationale: AngelList documents some of this story. Convertible notes appear as holdings on the stakeholder dashboard, stakeholders can accept issued instruments by e-signature, founders can launch a round and close investors, and a conversion workflow produces an Excel pro forma and records executed SAFE/note conversions on the cap table. However, there is no explicit evidence that SAFEs or convertible notes are drafted and sent in-platform. The conversion docs describe recording conversions that were legally executed elsewhere, and the FAQ about moving to J.P. Morgan or Pulley leaves current availability unclear. Missing for 10: documented in-platform SAFE/note creation and sending, explicit e-signing of SAFEs/notes, automatic cap-table modeling of caps/discounts at issuance, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create, send, and e-sign SAFEs or convertible notes in-platform, and they land on the cap table with their conversion terms modeled

citations.quote: Launch your round or RUV, close investors, and collect capital
It will produce an Excel-based pro forma (the format that your legal team and prospective investors will want to see it in because it contains the underlying formulas).
Once you've legally executed a SAFE/Convertible Note conversion, you can record the conversion and upload the conversion agreements in your cap table
All holdings (convertible notes, shares, transfers, etc) from all of a stakeholder's companies that are on AngelList are available in the dashboard.
Once logged in, you can accept and acknowledge receipt of the instrument through an e-signature.
